mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which increases infection risk when combined with tobramycin; additionally, tobramycin is nephrotoxic and methimazole may impair renal function, increasing aminoglycoside accumulation.
action: Monitor complete blood count and renal function regularly; assess for signs of infection and ototoxicity; ensure adequate hydration and consider tobramycin dosing adjustments based on renal function.
